matched_tasks.objective: Produce a mechanically scored hypothesis and bounded experiment plan from a held-out research prompt.
Repair a held-out falsifiable research plan after one negative experimental observation.
Select a retained result from conflicting held-out experimental traces.

sibling_checkpoint.selection: highest deterministic score; candidate_id ascending breaks exact ties

scorer.name: deterministic_task_metric_v1
scorer.advantage_rule: At least one median metric improves and neither worsens; exact replay and safety must pass.

decision.reason: The harness and frozen protocol are ready, but no matched native model observations have been recorded.
decision.next_action: Record both arms on all three held-out tasks with the same model, budgets, scorer, and sandbox; then run the fail-closed evaluator.
